decode_ratio_caveat: decode_ratio counts RDKit-parseable decodes and is NOT a chemistry metric.  MEASURED, a head predicting BOND_NO_BOND for every pair scores 0.977 here (loose atoms parse trivially) and 0.219 once it predicts real bond classes, i.e. the metric is anti-correlated with correctness.  Read it together with bond_f1 / bond_recall and with the gen_* chemistry fields (largest_fragment_frac, single_fragment_ratio, metal_ratio).
